# FAIL

## Requirement Summary

"When a user selects a Condenser Type and Refrigerant, the Unit Type dropdown should be populated and filtered by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant. After a Unit Type is selected, the Unit Size dropdown should be populated and filtered by the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type."

## Reviewer Findings

- F1 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The ticket does not specify whether entries with isActive:false should be excluded from the filtered dropdowns." | "Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on whether inactive entries should be omitted from the dropdowns."
- F2 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "It is unclear how the selected Condenser Type is represented in the SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant data for filtering, as the example only shows parent refrigerants." | "Clarify with the ticket owner how the Condenser Type should be represented in the SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant parent array for filtering."
- F3 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The behavior when no entries match the filter criteria (e.g., empty dropdown) is not defined." | "Obtain clarification on the expected UI behavior when the filter yields no matching entries."
- F4 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The case sensitivity or exact matching rules for comparing selected values to parent array values are not defined." | "Clarify with the ticket owner whether comparisons should be case‑sensitive and whether exact string matching is required."

## Open Ambiguities

- /ambiguities/0 | "The ticket does not specify whether entries with isActive:false should be excluded from the filtered dropdowns."
- /ambiguities/1 | "It is unclear how the selected Condenser Type is represented in the SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant data for filtering, as the example only shows parent refrigerants."
- /ambiguities/2 | "The behavior when no entries match the filter criteria (e.g., empty dropdown) is not defined."
- /ambiguities/3 | "The case sensitivity or exact matching rules for comparing selected values to parent array values are not defined."

## Final Disposition

FAIL

## Governance Reasons

- OPEN_FINDINGS
- OPEN_AMBIGUITIES
